executive_summary: The Indian stock market saw updates on July 2, 2026, while the US stock market ended slightly lower. Global markets are reacting to geopolitics and oil prices, and the tech sector is abuzz with the formation of the Frontier Model Forum and the launch of new AI models. Meanwhile, the HR landscape in India is experiencing layoffs, hiring decline, and high job mobility, mirroring global workforce transformation and layoff trends. Inflation and interest rates remain key macroeconomic concerns, driving market volatility and business decisions.
